children: Without fund traders throwing their full weight into participating in the prediction markets, young traders utilizing AI tools are making a lot of money in these markets. "The majority of really sharp money in the space right now is what we call 'garage band traders,'" says Seni Thomas, CEO of Edge Markets, during a panel discussion at the NEXTPredict Summit held in New York this week. While fund traders are expected to take the lead in the market segment, some analysts anticipate that trading may soon serve as an alternative to working a traditional job. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
